japan.name: Japan
japan.description: A harmonious blend of ancient tradition and modern innovation, where serene temples stand alongside neon-lit cityscapes.

china.name: China
china.description: Vast landscapes ranging from misty karst mountains to ancient imperial cities, with thousands of years of history at every turn.

south-korea.name: South Korea
south-korea.description: A dynamic fusion of cutting-edge technology, vibrant pop culture, and serene Buddhist temples nestled in mountain valleys.

thailand.name: Thailand
thailand.description: Golden temples, turquoise waters, and legendary street food — the Land of Smiles never fails to enchant.

vietnam.name: Vietnam
vietnam.description: From the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, Vietnam is a feast for the senses.

indonesia.name: Indonesia
indonesia.description: An archipelago of 17,000 islands offering volcanic landscapes, pristine beaches, and ancient temples shrouded in mist.

philippines.name: Philippines
philippines.description: Crystal-clear lagoons, towering limestone cliffs, and some of the friendliest people you'll ever meet.

india.name: India
india.description: A subcontinent of extraordinary diversity — from the Taj Mahal to Kerala's backwaters, every region tells a different story.

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.description: A gleaming city-state where futuristic gardens meet hawker stalls, and every neighborhood has its own character.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.description: A melting pot of Malay, Chinese, and Indian cultures, with rainforests, islands, and some of Southeast Asia's best food.

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.description: The cultural heart of Japan, home to thousands of temples, traditional tea houses, and stunning seasonal beauty.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: March-May (cherry blossoms) and October-November (autumn foliage)
guide.gettingThere: From Tokyo: 2h 15min by Shinkansen bullet train

tokyo.name: Tokyo
tokyo.description: A mesmerizing metropolis where ultra-modern skyscrapers stand beside ancient shrines, offering endless discoveries.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: March-May and October-November for mild weather
guide.gettingThere: Narita or Haneda International Airport — major global hub

hokkaido.name: Hokkaido
hokkaido.description: Japan's northern frontier — powder snow, lavender fields, and untouched wilderness.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: February (snow festivals) or July-August (lavender season)
guide.gettingThere: From Tokyo: 1h 40min flight to New Chitose Airport

zhangjiajie.name: Zhangjiajie
zhangjiajie.description: Towering sandstone pillars that inspired Avatar's floating mountains — a landscape unlike anywhere else on Earth.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-June and September-October
guide.gettingThere: Fly to Zhangjiajie Hehua Airport, or high-speed rail from Changsha

guilin.name: Guilin
guilin.description: Karst mountains rising from misty rivers — the landscape that has inspired Chinese painters for centuries.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-October
guide.gettingThere: Guilin Liangjiang Airport or high-speed rail from Guangzhou (3h)

jiuzhaigou.name: Jiuzhaigou Valley
jiuzhaigou.description: A kaleidoscope of turquoise lakes, multi-tiered waterfalls, and snow-capped peaks in Sichuan's mountain wilderness.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: September-November (autumn colors)
guide.gettingThere: Fly to Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, then 1.5h drive

lijiang.name: Lijiang
lijiang.description: An ancient town of cobblestone streets and wooden houses, set against the dramatic backdrop of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-May and September-October
guide.gettingThere: Lijiang Sanyi International Airport, or overnight train from Kunming

jeju.name: Jeju Island
jeju.description: South Korea's volcanic island paradise — dramatic coastlines, lush countryside, and unique lava tube caves.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-June and September-November
guide.gettingThere: 1h flight from Seoul, or ferry from Busan

seoul.name: Seoul
seoul.description: A city where royal palaces and hipster neighborhoods coexist, offering world-class food, shopping, and nightlife.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: March-May and September-November
guide.gettingThere: Incheon International Airport — major Asian hub

busan.name: Busan
busan.description: South Korea's coastal gem — colorful hillside villages, fresh seafood markets, and beautiful beaches.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: May-June and September-October
guide.gettingThere: Gimhae Airport or KTX high-speed rail from Seoul (2.5h)

chiang-mai.name: Chiang Mai
chiang-mai.description: The cultural capital of northern Thailand — ancient temples, night bazaars, and lush mountain landscapes.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: November-February (cool season)
guide.gettingThere: Chiang Mai International Airport, 1h 15min from Bangkok

phuket.name: Phuket
phuket.description: Thailand's largest island — stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and crystal-clear Andaman waters.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: November-April (dry season)
guide.gettingThere: Phuket International Airport, direct flights from many Asian cities

bangkok.name: Bangkok
bangkok.description: A city of contrasts — glittering temples, floating markets, rooftop bars, and the world's best street food.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: November-February (cool and dry)
guide.gettingThere: Suvarnabhumi Airport — major Southeast Asian hub

ha-long-bay.name: Ha Long Bay
ha-long-bay.description: Thousands of limestone islands rising from emerald waters — a UNESCO World Heritage Site of breathtaking beauty.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: March-May and September-November
guide.gettingThere: From Hanoi: 2.5h drive to Ha Long City, then boat

hoi-an.name: Hoi An
hoi-an.description: An ancient trading port where lantern-lit streets, tailor shops, and riverside cafes create an unforgettable atmosphere.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: February-April (dry and pleasant)
guide.gettingThere: Fly to Da Nang Airport, then 30min drive

bali.name: Bali
bali.description: The Island of the Gods — terraced rice paddies, volcanic peaks, and a spiritual energy that draws visitors back again and again.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-October (dry season)
guide.gettingThere: Ngurah Rai International Airport — direct flights from major Asian cities

komodo.name: Komodo Island
komodo.description: Home to the world's largest lizards and surrounded by some of the most biodiverse marine waters on Earth.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: April-December
guide.gettingThere: Fly to Labuan Bajo (Flores), then boat to Komodo

boracay.name: Boracay
boracay.description: A tiny island with powdery white sand beaches and legendary sunsets that consistently rank among the world's best.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: November-May (dry season)
guide.gettingThere: Fly to Caticlan or Kalibo Airport, then boat transfer

el-nido.name: El Nido
el-nido.description: Towering limestone cliffs, hidden lagoons, and pristine beaches — the crown jewel of Palawan.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: November-May (dry season)
guide.gettingThere: Fly to El Nido Airport or Puerto Princesa, then van transfer

agra.name: Agra
agra.description: Home to the Taj Mahal — the world's most famous monument to love, and one of the Seven Wonders of the World.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: October-March (cooler months)
guide.gettingThere: From Delhi: 2h by Gatimaan Express train

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.description: The Pink City — a royal tapestry of palaces, forts, and bazaars in the heart of Rajasthan.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: October-March
guide.gettingThere: Jaipur International Airport, or 4h drive/train from Delhi

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.description: India's tropical paradise — palm-fringed backwaters, spice plantations, and Ayurvedic wellness retreats.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: September-March
guide.gettingThere: Cochin International Airport — direct flights from major cities

gardens-by-the-bay.name: Gardens by the Bay
gardens-by-the-bay.description: A futuristic botanical wonderland with towering Supertrees and cloud forests in the heart of Singapore.

guide.bestTime: Year-round destination (tropical climate)
guide.gettingThere: MRT to Bayfront Station, 5min walk

marina-bay.name: Marina Bay
marina-bay.description: Singapore's dazzling waterfront district — iconic skyline, world-class dining, and the famous infinity pool.

guide.bestTime: Year-round destination
guide.gettingThere: MRT to Bayfront or Marina Bay Station

langkawi.name: Langkawi
langkawi.description: A duty-free archipelago of 99 islands — mangrove forests, cable car rides, and some of Malaysia's best beaches.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: December-March (dry season)
guide.gettingThere: Langkawi International Airport, or ferry from Kuala Kedah

kuala-lumpur.name: Kuala Lumpur
kuala-lumpur.description: A vibrant capital where the iconic Petronas Towers pierce the sky above bustling street markets and colonial architecture.

guide.bestTime: Best time to visit: May-July and December-February
guide.gettingThere: KLIA — major Southeast Asian hub with budget airline connections

footer.aboutText: iTour.asia is your curated guide to Asia's most beautiful destinations, featuring professional photography and practical travel guides.
